comments.author: Qazalbash
comments.body: Inverse Wishart distribution (#2103) was introduced after the 0.19.0 release (#2060). The latest documentation is of current HEAD. If you want to use it through a release then wait until 0.20.0 release (#2128), otherwise use [nightly](https://num.pyro.ai/en/latest/getting_started.html#installation).
